title: Efforts to Facilitate Low-income or Illiterate Persons' Access to Legal Aid Bureau Services Via Non-digital Means
what_it_is: Efforts to Facilitate Low-income or Illiterate Persons' Access to Legal Aid Bureau Services Via Non-digital Means

sections.label: Legal Aid Bureau in-person services
sections.summary: The Legal Aid Bureau provides in-person help at the Ministry of Law Services Centre, with legal advice also by video conferencing at ServiceSG, FSC and SSO locations.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: The Legal Aid Bureau (LAB) provides in person services at the Ministry of Law Services Centre (MSC).

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: The staff there can assist those who are illiterate or not digitally savvy or speak languages other than English.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: Applicants can take the means test at MSC and receive legal advice or legal aid if successful.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: Those receiving legal aid, which entails assistance with court proceedings, can be guided by MSC or LAB staff, either in person or by phone.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: Legal advice is also available in person at MSC, or through video conferencing at any of the nine ServiceSG centres.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Law (Mr Murali Pillai) (for the Minister for Law)
sentences.text: Clients of Family Service Centres (FSCs) or Social Service Offices (SSOs) can also receive legal advice via video conferencing at 29 FSCs and 24 SSOs.

sections.label: Digitally illiterate persons assistance strategy
sections.summary: A digitally illiterate person should not be sent to digital portals, and resources are devoted to help them.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: As a matter of system, a digitally illiterate person should not be sent to digital portals.

sentences.speaker: Mr Murali Pillai
sentences.text: As I mentioned in my reply, we have a strategy and we, in fact, devote resources to help these digitally illiterate persons.
